label: 0.6 cm by Hand
description: A 0.6 cm hand pick stitch is set further from the edge and is individually pierced by hand, producing a clearly visible row of deliberate, evenly spaced surface stitches that form one of the most recognisable decorative signatures in high tailoring. Known as a 'swelled edge' in English tailoring tradition, this detail was a staple of Anthony Sinclair's work for Sean Connery's James Bond suits and is closely associated with the clean-cut English bespoke aesthetic. The slightly wider stitch distance makes each individual pick more visible and gives the lapel a bolder, more sporting character than the near-invisible 0.15 cm version.
